chapter_seo_title: Heavenly Moon Sect Tier List: Why Han Li’s "Worst" Job is His Best Bet
chapter_meta_description: Han Li avoids the spotlight and chooses a quiet herb garden over flashy alchemy. A masterclass in strategic obscurity and the art of winning by doing nothing.
og_title: A Domain of Quiet Growth: Why Han Li Picks the Garden
og_description: Han Li finds a perfect hiding spot. This quiet chapter shows why setting up the right base is more important than any fight.
twitter_title: The Best Job in the Sect?
twitter_description: Han Li chooses a boring job on purpose. It’s the smartest move he could make.

lore_anchors.definition: A low-status sect member assigned to labor-based duties in exchange for basic cultivation resources, distinct from personal disciples who receive direct mentorship.
